title: Question: gradient sf_select step-4 upgrade_count hysteresis deviates from spec 2a.8 pseudocode
description: Found during b7z9.30 decomposition. Spec 2a.8 step 4: 'IF (Neighbor.EMA_SNR > 8) AND (Density < 5) THEN SF = MAX(7, SF - 1)'. C impl (lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/gradient.c ~line 322) adds a third condition: entry->sf.upgrade_count >= LICHEN_UPGRADE_COUNT_THRESHOLD (hysteresis on how many upgrades already happened). Not in the spec pseudocode; no vector pins it (ccp16/ccp_load_balancing don't cover adaptive paths). Either the spec should document the hysteresis (anti-flapping rationale) or the impl should drop it. Needs Mark's call — spec-authoring vs impl change, and Rust rf_health.rs parity depends on the answer. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.30.
